problem: Members cannot reserve a book that is out. They ask at the desk, and the desk keeps a paper list for each book. Two members can be promised the same copy, and a returned copy can go back on the open shelf while someone still waits for it.

users.need: Places a hold from the book page, sees their place in line, and picks the copy up from the hold shelf.
Shelves a returned copy for the next member in line, and cancels a hold when a member asks at the desk.

notFor: Branch managers. Reports on which books people wait for come in a later plan.
goals: A member can hold any book whose copies are all out, without asking at the desk.
Each returned copy goes to the first member in line, and that member hears about it the same day.

nonGoals.what: Holds on a book with a copy on the open shelf
nonGoals.why: The member can take that copy now.
Few members asked for it, and it doubles the cases the line must handle.

requirements.title: Place a hold on a book that is out
requirements.text: When every copy of a book is lent, a member can join the line for it from the book page and sees their place.

requirements.title: The first in line gets the returned copy
requirements.text: A returned copy goes to the first member in line, and nobody else can take it from the hold shelf.

requirements.title: Three opening days to pick it up
requirements.text: The member hears the same day the copy is shelved, and has three opening days to collect it. After that it passes to the next member.

requirements.title: See every hold in one place
requirements.text: A member sees each hold with their place in line, or the day to pick it up by.

requirements.title: Cancel a hold
requirements.text: A member can cancel any hold, and a desk librarian can cancel one for them. The line moves up.

rollout.says: Desk librarians try holds on their own library cards for one week.
Members of the central branch see Place a hold on the book page.
Every member sees it, and the desk stops taking paper holds.

metric.name: Holds collected
metric.target: 8 in 10 holds end with the member picking the copy up
